extraRuntime.game/audio: Baked game audio cues (.m4a) generated via Scenario and tools/audio/bake.mjs; not image art, staged verbatim into game/dist/ and OTA bundles

$prefixRule: The prefix is always the full category name — never abbreviated. Use 'character' not 'char', 'projectile' not 'proj', 'creature' not 'crtr'. prefix must equal folder.

items.$comment: Drop icons, two per item: 'items_<id>.png' is the detailed art and 'items_<id>-small.png' the bold redraw that stays readable a couple of dozen pixels across. Both are packed into the items_drops atlas by tools/pack_items_atlas.py.

location.$comment: Dungeon location icons, 'location_<id>.png', one landmark vignette per location drawn on the dungeon screen's tab bar. tools/pack_location_icons.py fits each cut-out into a 112px box inside the main atlas's 128px 'dungeon_*' cell so the six sit at one scale.

lootbox.$comment: Reward chests, 'lootbox_<tier>-<closed|open>.png', and treasure piles, 'lootbox_loot-<n>.png', finished 512x512 cells placed on the shipped wood chest's footprint by tools/place_chests.py and packed into the lootbox atlas (and main <tier>_icon) by tools/repaint_atlas.py.

source.name: source
source.purpose: Pipeline inputs and generation artifacts (green-screen PNGs, description JSONs, prompt TXTs)

_work.name: _work
_work.purpose: All throwaway/disposable files (generation candidates, processing intermediates, contact sheets)

_trash.name: _trash
_trash.purpose: Soft-deleted assets — mirrors original relative path for easy recovery

final.$comment: Final files (category root) have no version, no variant, no qualifier. The prefix is always in the filename regardless of folder.

working.$comment: Working files (_work/, source/) carry iteration metadata. On promotion to the category root, _v<N>, -variant, and _qualifier are all stripped.

build.$comment: Build-time downsizing. Emitted assets are resized to maxDisplayPx x dprCap x headroom; sources under assetRoot are never modified. See the Build-Time Downsizing section of SKILL.md.

visdev.purpose: Visual development and research, organized by topic
